o: Split passes into first half (timestamp ≤ '45:00') and second half; for each team-half, dominance = (successful passes) − (interceptions), where a pass made by a player of team T scores +1 if received by a teammate and −1 otherwise. Zero-padded 'MM:SS' strings compare correctly lexicographically, so a simple CASE on the timestamp assigns halves. Aggregate with a conditional SUM over a double join (passer's team, receiver's team).
k: Join Passes to Teams twice — once for pass_from, once for pass_to — to compare team names.
Half number derives from time_stamp ≤ '45:00' (string comparison works due to zero padding).
Conditional aggregation SUM(CASE WHEN same team THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) computes dominance in one pass.

a.i: Attach both teams' names to each pass, derive the half, then group by team and half summing ±1.
s: JOIN Teams tf ON pass_from = tf.player_id and Teams tt ON pass_to = tt.player_id.
Compute half_number via CASE WHEN time_stamp <= '45:00' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END.
GROUP BY team_name, half_number with SUM(CASE WHEN tf.team_name = tt.team_name THEN 1 ELSE -1 END).

c.python:
-- MySQL solution
SELECT tf.team_name,
       CASE WHEN p.time_stamp <= '45:00' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS half_number,
       SUM(CASE WHEN tf.team_name = tt.team_name THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS dominance
FROM Passes p
JOIN Teams tf ON p.pass_from = tf.player_id
JOIN Teams tt ON p.pass_to = tt.player_id
GROUP BY tf.team_name, half_number
ORDER BY tf.team_name, half_number;

a.sp: O(T · 2) output rows plus join buffers.

a.n: Approach 2: Derived Table then Join to Team List
a.i: Compute per-pass signed scores in a subquery, aggregate in another, and LEFT JOIN from Teams so that team/half combinations with no passes could be filled with 0 via COALESCE — more robust if the judge expects every team in both halves.
s: Inner query: per pass, compute team_name (of passer), half_number, and score ±1.
Aggregate the inner query by team and half.
LEFT JOIN from a Teams × halves skeleton, wrapping dominance in COALESCE(..., 0).

c.python:
-- MySQL solution
SELECT t.team_name, h.half_number, COALESCE(SUM(s.score), 0) AS dominance
FROM Teams t
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS half_number UNION SELECT 2) h
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT tf.team_name,
           CASE WHEN p.time_stamp <= '45:00' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS half_number,
           CASE WHEN tf.team_name = tt.team_name THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS score
    FROM Passes p
    JOIN Teams tf ON p.pass_from = tf.player_id
    JOIN Teams tt ON p.pass_to = tt.player_id
) s ON s.team_name = t.team_name AND s.half_number = h.half_number
GROUP BY t.team_name, h.half_number
ORDER BY t.team_name, h.half_number;

w: Start with Approach 1; offer Approach 2 only if the discussion turns to teams with no passes in a half (whether they should appear with 0 depends on the judge — check the expected output). Pitfalls: boundary minute 45:00 belongs to half 1, and forgetting that interceptions are scored against the PASSING team. Follow-up: per-player dominance, or dominance per 15-minute segment.
